introduction: Stephen Murphy is a Scottish / New Zealand actor . Born in Glasgow and later moving to New Zealand when he was still a child. Completing schooling he moved into the world of on air announcing in radio.Stephen now lives and works in Los Angeles.An ex Australian Outback miner for 8 years , Stephen has lived many lives within this one . His comedic timing has gotten him roles but also thru many situations in life .A former professional dancer in his early years coupled with a background in mixed martial arts and mining , he is no stranger to hard work and his physicality shows this . He is able to move between the energies of feminine and masculine like a dance , something many strong larger men are unable to do .An immense respect for writing , production and the craft , he takes all opportunities very seriously and treats each as a gift .Stephen's voice/control and accent ability is second to none . With an ever expanding repertoire of accents he is a favorite for voiceover and audio books .
